items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I often go, went down that St. Catharine. John. Yeah. And to hear him, you know, just to hear him play.

ctx.x: He used to play some music. I often go, went down that St. Catharine. John. Yeah. And to hear him, you know, just to hear him play. I danced a few pieces, but I never was fond of dancing. I fond of making you dance. Yeah. I was very fond of making you dance. Oh, they used to dance in that temple, they called it. Yeah, the roof garden too. Yeah, the boy used to play there. He is crippled. He used to play the violin. He had a, look like a funny foot or something. He used to play up on the roof garden, they call it.…
Well, they made an office building out of it now.
